name: Program Upload
summary: Adversaries may attempt to upload a program from a PLC to gather information about an industrial process. Uploading a program may allow them to acquire and study the underlying logic. Methods of program upload include vendor software, which enables the user to upload and read a program running on a PLC. This software can be used to upload the target program to a workstation, jump box, or an interfacing device.

analytics.name: Analytic 1893
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol session reading back the user program from a field device to a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, where the session byte count is consistent with a substantial portion of the device's program memory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering…
